Highlights: - Discover new hobbies to pass the time and boost morale. - Play musical instruments, learn hundreds of songs, sing, form a band, and more. - Become the life of the party with functional jukeboxes, dj booths, disco balls and fully realized dance hobby with hundreds of dance moves. - Care for your survivor and turn your safehouse into a haven of cleanliness and tranquility with dozens of new interactible items and objects like mirrors, combs, bathtubs, showers, toothbrushes, sponges, perfumes, and more. - Perfect for players looking to personalize their experience or find new ways to engage with the game.
